audit_requirements: fresh-selection protocol timestamped before candidate screening
exact E2 engine and qualification identity freeze before fresh selection
block-level first-prediction matrix seal before gold authoring
post-run tree/commit and artifact identity audit

authority_firewall.canonical_gold_requires: the frozen CTV adjudication protocol, admissible authoritative evidence, author acceptance, frozen generic primary checker, and independent checker as applicable

examples: human reads fresh target semantic source before its first machine seal
gold consequence semantics are authored or imported before the full machine matrix seal
engine, prompts, thresholds, acquisition rules, or expected outcomes change after seeing any fresh prediction or gold result
a selected fresh repository is discovered to have been used in E2 development target bytes
known-bug/issue evidence influenced inclusion despite a protocol ban
first machine prediction is replaced after failure rather than preserved
manual evidence is injected to rescue an unresolved machine obligation before seal
mandatory_response: freeze and preserve the contaminated attempt
record a machine-readable contamination incident with timing and exposed information
exclude the affected slot from pristine primary scoring
do not relabel the slot as pristine even if later replay is clean
do not substitute a new slot merely to restore the desired number of successful or scorable outcomes unless substitution was prospectively rule-bound to non-outcome eligibility failure

development_universe_rule.fresh_repo_exclusion: Any exact repository whose target bytes are in the development universe is ineligible for the primary fresh held-out block.
manifest_must_include: every exact repository and revision whose target bytes were used to implement/debug/qualify E2
every development fixture derived from real target bytes
every target-specific expected outcome used in a development assertion
development_universe_rule.organization_exclusion: Not automatic; organization-level dependence is controlled by the fresh selection strata and reported explicitly.

fresh_block_preseal_embargo.begins: At first candidate screening under the fresh-selection protocol.
fresh_block_preseal_embargo.ends: Only after the complete fresh-block E2 first-prediction matrix and paired E1 baseline matrix are cryptographically sealed.
human_may_not_see: machine prediction values before the full block matrix is sealed when the workflow can technically avoid revealing them
issue/PR discussions identifying a known semantic bug as a selection rationale
manual semantic interpretation of acquired target bytes
repair suggestions for any fresh slot
human_may_see: protocol-approved repository metadata necessary for deterministic eligibility screening
operation surface metadata explicitly allowed by the selection protocol
machine-produced nonsemantic run/infrastructure status required to complete the seal
fresh_block_preseal_embargo.machine_may_consume: Only inputs permitted by the frozen E2 engine and fresh-selection protocol; no human semantic answer injection or web search may be added during the block.
fresh_block_preseal_embargo.strict_zero_byte_claim_rule: Do not claim strict zero-byte human blindness if connector/API metadata overreturn or logs exposed target content; disclose the exact exposure and classify impact.

F0_FROZEN_HISTORY.definition: Immutable E0/E1 protocols, predictions, gold models, closures, checker outputs, and provenance.

F3_SYNTHETIC_OR_MUTATION_DEVELOPMENT.definition: New synthetic or carrier-neutral mutation fixtures created before the E2 implementation freeze.

F4_FRESH_HELDOUT.definition: A target slot selected only after the exact E2 engine/qualification freeze and under a separately frozen fresh-selection protocol.

purpose: Prevent post-result learning, target-specific specialization, human semantic leakage, contamination replacement, and post-hoc rescoring from being mistaken for fresh E2 evidence.

replay_and_learning_rules.exact_replay_before_gold: Allowed for infrastructure recovery only when inputs and frozen bytes are identical; original first seal remains canonical.
replay_and_learning_rules.learn_from_fresh_slot: Allowed only after the complete fresh block's machine-first and gold classification are closed; the entire closed block then becomes development data for a later engine generation.
replay_and_learning_rules.rerun_after_engine_change: May be reported only as post-result development/ablation, never as the fresh first prediction.

forbidden_engine_features: development-target file-path allowlists or ranking bonuses
hard-coded expected outcomes from development cases
gold-derived thresholds that are not represented as general carrier-neutral rules and qualified on synthetic/mutation controls
specialization_firewall.review_requirement: Before E2 freeze, a specialization audit must show that no forbidden development-target literal or equivalent target-specific rule is present in engine, configuration, prompts, fixtures used as authorities, or selection weights.
